items.content_text:
Security forces have killed wanted Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist Lateef Bhat in south Kashmir’s Kulgam district, ending an eight-day operation linked to the November 11 attack on CRPF personnel.
Officials said Bhat, a key accused in the attack that injured three CRPF personnel, was tracked down after an intensive manhunt. Security forces reportedly urged him to surrender before launching the final operation.
